description: Source code for IEEE 802.15.4 shell module in Zephyr RTOS, providing command implementations for network interface configuration and scanning.

methods.name: cmd_ieee802154_ack
methods.description: Sets or unsets the IEEE 802.15.4 acknowledgment flag on the network interface.

methods.name: parse_extended_address
methods.description: Parses an ASCII HEX string into a big endian binary extended address.

methods.name: cmd_ieee802154_associate
methods.description: Associates the device with a specified PAN ID and address.

methods.name: cmd_ieee802154_disassociate
methods.description: Disassociates the device from the current network.

methods.name: parse_channel_set
methods.description: Parses a string representing a set of channels into a bitmask.

methods.name: print_coordinator_address
methods.description: Formats the coordinator address (extended or short) into a string.

methods.name: scan_result_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked upon scan result event, printing network info.

methods.name: cmd_ieee802154_scan
methods.description: Performs an active or passive scan over specified channels.
